owner: root Karen only; read-only support; Codex Work; no formal Pro/Ultra/human claim
purpose: Compare actual generate cached logits and full-prefix no-cache logits at the same preserved SHOP prefixes, before any further training or free-generation proposal. This is not proof that cache is faulty or a product-quality measurement.
cost_exclusions: preparation/recovery/holding/storage/network/tax etc extra; no live rate requery; not total billing
cpu_source_and_prefix_check: completed; no pretrained model load/forward; actual new4B replay unexecuted
success: 2 identical-input logit comparisons, margins/ranks/deltas, exact observed forward counts, unchanged source/input/weights. Not semantic adoption or product success.
interpretation: Name-token divergence alone is not semantic failure. BF16 logit difference or near-tied argmax alone is not a bug. Same invalid choice in both paths excludes cache as cause only at that prefix. Do not infer whole-model correctness, material sufficiency or required learning amount.
stop: One run only. Timeout, identity mismatch, missing comparison, nonfinite score, unexpected callback/count or other failure: preserve partial report and close. No retry/repair/fallback, added updates, new free generation, CMEE call or next paid run.

approval.scope: Immediately following the concrete one-SHOP same-prefix comparison proposal; one execution, max180 seconds, GPU processing prorated max USD0.014; preparation/recovery/holding etc extra. No training/free generation/new CMEE/retry.
